items.title: Building advertising for the way people use AI
items.excerpt: OpenAI introduces a new visual ad format in ChatGPT and expands measurement tools, attribution partnerships, and brand suitability controls for advertisers. The visual format starts testing later this month in the US with an initial group of advertisers.

items.title: OpenAI launches visual ads that appear alongside image generation results
items.excerpt: The new ads will begin to appear later this month in the U.S. only for now, and will feature products and services from an initial test group of advertisers.

items.title: OpenAI moves to make ChatGPT Ads more measurable — and more visual
items.excerpt: OpenAI answers advertiser complaints with a new format, measurement tools and brand suitability testing to ChatGPT Ads.

items.title: OpenAI Testing Visual ChatGPT Ad Format
items.excerpt: OpenAI announced "new visual ad format in ChatGPT" that it will be testing "later this month in the US with an initial group of advertisers." The new visual ad format is an "ad format during image generation in ChatGPT." So if you ask ChatGPT to make an image for you, it will show a special ad for that process.

items.title: OpenAI Is Piloting Brand Suitability Controls With DoubleVerify and IAS
items.excerpt: The company is also testing a larger, image-led ad format and expanding its measurement partners.

items.title: TikTok Adds an AI Shopping Assistant and Lets Users Buy Direct From Brands
items.excerpt: The shopping assistant gives guidance on product details, shipping, sizing, availability, and purchasing

items.title: TikTok rolls out an AI shopping assistant and one-click checkout
items.excerpt: TikTok describes its new Shopping Assistant as a conversational AI agent designed to help users discover and purchase products.

items.title: TikTok broadens agentic AI play, brings global ad network to US
items.excerpt: New products timed to Advertising Week see the video-sharing app boasting of its economic might ahead of the busy holiday season.

items.title: Google Ads AI Campaign Localization Tool For Search Campaigns
items.excerpt: Google Ads has a new AI campaign localization tool for Search campaigns (beta), at least according to a new help document I found late last week. "You can use the AI campaign localization tool to quickly localize entire Search campaigns for new languages and regions using generative AI," Google wrote in the help document.

items.title: Google Search Spam Updates Use AI To Find AI Spam
items.excerpt: Google spoke at the three-day Google Search Central Live Deep Dive event in Europe about why it has rolled out so many spam updates in 2026, according to John Campbell's recap at We Are Roast. He said that Google has been doing more spam updates because there is so much more new content than before. He also said Google is using AI to catch more spam.

items.title: Google's Mueller Says AI Crawlers Access Sitemaps & RSS In His Logs
items.excerpt: Google's John Mueller says AI training crawlers usually don't offer sitemap submission and suggests default sitemap names or RSS feeds to help them find sites.

items.title: Google Is Fighting SERP Tracking. AI Agents May Make It Worse
items.excerpt: Google is slamming the door on SERP tracking, but AI agents may be giving it more reason to shut down automated queries.

items.title: OpenAI To Watermark ChatGPT Text In The EU, Opens API Opt-In
items.excerpt: OpenAI will add an invisible watermark to ChatGPT and Codex text in the EU. Its tests show editing can weaken it.

items.title: Gap unveils AI-assisted shopping, three decades after its first website
items.excerpt: Starting Monday, customers can get recommendations from the Alta Daily and Daydream platforms. Banana Republic and Old Navy are also launching conversational shopping agents.

items.title: Pricing tactics come under scrutiny in the age of AI
items.excerpt: Concern is growing that retailers are using customer data to engage in dynamic pricing, and it is putting more companies on the defensive.

items.title: OpenAI is adding text watermarking in ChatGPT and Codex
items.excerpt: ﻿It’s launching textGrain watermarking in the EU, but OpenAI says it won’t be the ‘global default’ yet.

items.title: Our approach to EU text provenance rules
items.excerpt: OpenAI explains how it is approaching text watermarking under EU provenance rules — where watermarks apply, how detection works, and why detector access starts with researchers.
